FN-ITEY66Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 230
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/06/2024
House Bill 230 as introduced would reduce receipts to the State General Fund and the Secretary
of State Corporations Fund by an estimated maximum of $560,000 and $240,000, annually,
respectively, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by repealing the requirement for certain
corporations to file an annual report and pay the associated $10 filing fee.
This bill would also reduce the administrative obligations of the Secretary to no longer collect
and maintain these reports.
